newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan July index of leading indicators down.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan July index of leading indicators down.

text.p: Taiwan's index of leading business indicators, which forecasts peaks and troughs in the business cycle, fell in July from June, the cabinet's Council for Economic Planning and Development said on Tuesday.
The index decreased 0.8 percentage point to 98.0 in July.
The index of coincident indicators rose, advancing 1.0 percentage point to 100.8 from a month earlier.
The council said the economy remained in a "yellow blue light" condition for the second consecutive month, indicating a possible slowdown.

Twenty-two percent of executives in the manufacturing industry said the economy would turn worse, slightly down from 23 percent in June, while 16 percent said the economy will improve, slighly down from 17 percent a month earlier.
Those who were pessimistic about the economy outnumbered those who were optimistic for the second straight time in 1996.
The rest said the economy would remain the same as the current situation.
